newsitem.title: USA: Progressive begins Internet insurance sales.
newsitem.headline: Progressive begins Internet insurance sales.

text.p: Progressive Corp has launched a new program allowing consumers to buy auto insurance over the Internet, making it possibly the first U.S. insurer to sell policies electronically.
Other U.S. insurers provide information about their products and rates over the Internet, but then require consumers to call a sales agent or the company to complete the transaction.
"A lot of them (insurance companies) are on the Internet now," said Jayna Neagle, a spokeswoman for the Insurance Information Institute.
"Not all offer (price) quotes," she said. "The bigger companies are offering quotes," she said.
But Progressive, a large U.S. auto insurer, now allows Minnesota residents to buy auto insurance over the Internet using their credit cards, spokesman Chuck Chokel said.
The Mayfield Village, Ohio-based company said its web site allows consumers to compare rates from Progressive as well as up to three other leading auto insurers.
If satisfied with the Progressive quote, the consumer can then choose to buy the insurance electronically.
Coverage begins as soon as the consumer completes the Internet transaction, Chokel said.
The company will then send the consumer a policy kit, which must be signed and returned to the company, he said.
If it is not returned, the policy will be cancelled, he said.
The program is currently restricted to Minnesota consumers because of regulatory issues involved with the sale of insurance, Chokel said.
Minnesota regulators gave Progressive permission to sell insurance electronically, Chokel said.
But laws governing the sale of insurance vary from state to state and often require that it be sold by a licensed agent, he said.
The National Association of Insurance Commissioners said it is currently exploring the regulatory issues regarding Internet insurance sales and has produced a white paper on the subject.
The Progressive's web site can be found at http://www.auto-insurance.com
